Dermatopathic lymphadenopathy is a nodal reaction, not soft-tissue calcinosis.
Myositis ossificans is heterotopic ossification related to muscle injury, not the familial/idiopathic calcific masses.
Chronic tophaceous gout is urate deposition; imaging shows extraosseous calcifications of tumoral calcinosis.
